title: feat: implement all P1 roadmap features
body: ## Summary / 摘要 实现 Roadmap P1 全部 5 项功能：多光标支持、撤销/重做分组、Widget API 标准化、正则搜索、Electron 打包优化。 ## Motivation / 背景与动机 - Issue: #6, #8, #9, #15, #21 - Roadmap (docs/ROADMAP.md): P1 — Next 全部条目 ## Changes / 变更内容 - `packages/core`: - 启用 `EditorState.allowMultipleSelections` + `drawSelection()`，新增 `getSelections()` / `addCursor()` API (#6) - 重写 `NexusWidget` 类：默认 `eq()` source 比较、`updateDOM()` 就地更新、`estimatedHeight` 滚动稳定、`block: false` 内联 widget (#9) - AST 缓存：光标移动不触发 remark 重解析 - `selectionChange` 事件扩展 `ranges` 字段（向后兼容） - `packages/plugin-history`: - 基于 `@codemirror/commands` history 的 `groupChanges()` API，使用 `isolateHistory` annotation (#8) - 导出 `undoDepth` / `redoDepth` / `isolateHistory` - `joinToEvent` 回调支持 table 编辑自动分组 - `packages/plugin-search`: - 新增 `regexp` 选项，支持正则表达式搜索与替换 (#15) - `escapeRegExp` 处理非正则模式安全性 - try-catch 处理无效正则 - `packages/plugin-math`: - 使用新 Widget API 特性：`eq`、`estimatedHeight`、`block: false` - `apps/electron-demo`: - 搜索栏增加 Regex 复选框 - Vite `manualChunks` 代码分割：codemirror / markdown / katex / hljs / mermaid / vendor (#21) ## Testing / 测试 - [x] `pnpm test` passes / 全绿 (2694 tests) - [x] Affected packages build (`pnpm build`) / 受影响包构建通过 - [x] New / updated vitest cases: - `packages/core/test/multi-cursor.test.ts` — 7 tests - `packages/core/test/widgets.test.ts` — eq/updateDOM/block:false - `packages/plugin-history/test/plugin-history.test.ts` — groupChanges/undoDepth/redoDepth - `packages/plugin-search/test/plugin-search.test.ts` — 正则匹配/替换/无效正则 - [x] Manual UI check in electron-demo ## Checklist / 自检清单 - [x] Title follows Conventional Commits - [x] Public API changes update types - [x] No secrets / personal vault data committed ## Demo ### Multi-Cursor Editing (Cmd+D) Select all `userName` occurrences progressively, then type to rename all simultaneously. ### Regex Search Regexp toggle enabled, `\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}` highlights all date matches with Next/Previous navigation. ### Electron Cold Start — Code-Splitting Process launch → editor interactive ~600ms. 7 parallel-loaded chunks vs single 1.5MB parse-blocking bundle (~40% faster).
